name: Fighting Back
overview: Scripture acknowledges the reality of conflict and the necessity of spiritual and moral vigilance, as seen in Psalms 144:1 where God is praised as the strength who teaches hands to fight. Ecclesiastes 3:8 reminds us there is a divinely appointed time for war and peace, emphasizing God's sovereignty over all seasons. However, Jesus teaches in Matthew 5:22 and 12:36 that anger and careless words bring judgment, urging believers to guard their hearts and speech even amid opposition. Ultimately, John 16:33 encourages believers to find peace and courage in Christ, who has overcome the world despite the tribulations they face.
